case.question: I just finished my masters can I stay in Ireland and look for a job

result.question: I just finished my masters can I stay in Ireland and look for a job
result.answer: You may be eligible for the Third Level Graduate Programme [3]. This programme allows you to remain in Ireland after your studies for 12 months to seek graduate level employment. To qualify, you must have been notified in writing by the relevant awarding body or institution on or after 1 January 2017 that you have achieved the award for which you had enrolled as a student [3].

case.question: What does Stamp 1G allow me to do

result.question: What does Stamp 1G allow me to do
result.answer:
Stamp 1G allows you to look for employment in Ireland under the Third Level Graduate Programme, subject to conditions [1]. You can work full time in accordance with employment law requirements, but you are not permitted to operate a business or be self-employed [1]. If your Stamp 1G expires, you must find a job that requires an employment permit and then follow the usual application process [1].

Additionally, Stamp 1G allows spouses or de facto partners of Critical Skills Employment Permit holders or researchers on a Hosting Agreement to take up employment without needing an employment permit [2].

case.question: What is Stamp 0

result.question: What is Stamp 0
result.answer: Stamp 0 indicates that you have been granted permission to reside in the State, confirming that you obey the laws of the State, should not become involved in criminal activity, and are continuously resident in the State for the duration of your permission [3]. However, it does not provide information on how to apply or what type of permission it is.

case.question: How do I renew my IRP card

result.question: How do I renew my IRP card
result.answer:
To renew your IRP card, you must apply online through the ISD's online renewal portal [3]. You will need a copy of your most recent IRP card and the biometric page of your current passport [2]. If you are not currently in possession of your IRP card, you will be required to include an explanation why [2].

You can apply to renew from 12 weeks prior to expiry of your current IRP [1] or [5], provided all documents are in order. Any applications submitted earlier than 12 weeks prior to expiry will be refused [1].

case.question: How much does the Critical Skills Employment Permit cost

result.question: How much does the Critical Skills Employment Permit cost
result.answer: The processing fee for a Critical Skills Employment Permit is €1,000 [1]. If an application is unsuccessful, 90% of the fee will be refunded to the applicant [1].

case.question: What is the minimum salary for a critical skills permit if I graduated recently

result.question: What is the minimum salary for a critical skills permit if I graduated recently
result.answer: If you have received your qualification within the 12 month period prior to the date of application for the employment permit, the minimum annual remuneration will be €36,848 [2].

case.question: How long do I have to stay with my first employer on a critical skills permit

result.question: How long do I have to stay with my first employer on a critical skills permit
result.answer: You must stay with your initial employer for a minimum period of 9 months [1].

case.question: What happens if I am made redundant while on a critical skills permit

result.question: What happens if I am made redundant while on a critical skills permit
result.answer: If you are made redundant while on a Critical Skills Employment Permit, you must notify the Employment Permits Section of the Department of Enterprise, Tourism and Employment within 4 weeks of the date of dismissal [1]. You will then have up to 6 months from the date of dismissal by reason of redundancy to seek alternative employment [2]. If you obtain a subsequent job offer with the same job title, your application for a new Critical Skills Employment Permit will still be considered [3].

case.question: When can I move from Stamp 1 to Stamp 4 with a critical skills permit

result.question: When can I move from Stamp 1 to Stamp 4 with a critical skills permit
result.answer: You may be eligible for a Stamp 4 permission upon completion of 21 months from commencement of employment in the State on the basis of a Critical Skills Employment Permit [5]. Commencement of employment is determined via an ‘Employment Detail Summary’, available on revenue.ie/myaccount [4].

result.question: Can my spouse work in Ireland if I hold a critical skills permit
result.answer: Yes, once your dependants/partners/spouses are resident in the State, they are eligible to seek any employment [1]. They can also apply for a Dependant/Partner/Spouse Employment Permit, which is currently issued free of charge [1].

case.question: How soon after arriving in Ireland do I have to register my permission

result.question: How soon after arriving in Ireland do I have to register my permission
result.answer:
You must register within 90 days [1, 2, 4]. Your passport will be endorsed with a landing stamp instructing that you register within this time frame [2, 4]. 

When possible, create an account on the Customer Service Portal and book an appointment as soon as you arrive in Ireland [2, 4].
